title: In the GST Council, neither side can win alone
sources: Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016

quiz.q: In the GST Council, the Centre's vote carries a weight of:
quiz.why: Right. One-third; all the states together have two-thirds.

review.note: Written and voiced by Claude (AI voices, Kokoro), 8 Nov 2026. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor. Check every number and date against the listed sources.

lines.say: GST replaced a tangle of central and state taxes.
And it created a council where neither side can win alone.

lines.say: GST began on the first of July, 2017.

lines.say: The Union Finance Minister chairs the GST Council.
Every state's finance minister sits on it.

beats.say: The Union Finance Minister chairs the GST Council. Every state's finance minister sits on it.

lines.say: A decision needs a three-quarter majority of weighted votes.
The Centre's vote counts for one-third, the states' for two-thirds. So neither can pass anything alone.
